items.prompt: Why should the verifier not require every seeded95%interval to contain the analytic price?
items.modelAnswer: A valid approximate95%procedure can miss in repeated samples;one seed is not coverage proof. Test arithmetic/reproducibility separately,assess repeated coverage with its own uncertainty and preserve independent units/model assumptions. Do not select favorable seeds or treat intervals as real-market prediction.

criteria.text: Separates deterministic tests from statistical assessment.
Avoids seed selection and prediction claims.
